_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 84 in the 16:03 run), SELECT MELEE WEAPON. Melee has no CUSTOMIZE screen, so the art is cropped from the same shot. Melee reports Hit Delay and Damage instead of the primary-weapon stat block, and has no trait chips.
name: Combat Knife

description.text: A lightweight serrated knife designed for fast attacks. Attacking enemies from the back or while they are prone will initiate a lethal takedown. Increases sprint speed when equipped.
